title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends
description: Animated series set before the Kalakeya invasion depicted in the movie, when Baahubali and Bhallaladeva are still both young princes of Mahizhmati.

episodes.title: S5-E1The Land Of The Rising Sun

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x1
episodes_data.description: A young Prince Baahubali and his brother Bhallaladeva are studying the royal arts of politics and warfare when a village nearby is attacked by bandits.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x2
episodes_data.description: Mahishmati is visited by the neighboring king and his children, on Shivagami's invitation, to work out an alliance. There's a ploy afoot.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x3
episodes_data.description: Baahubali faces the consequences of his choice but the repercussions will go far beyond what he had possibly imagined.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x4
episodes_data.description: Needing allies against the Barbarian horde determined to pillage Mahishmati, Sivagami orders Baahubali, Bhallaladeva, and Katappa to seek an unimaginable alliance with the Kalakeya.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x5
episodes_data.description: When people believe the forests of Mahishmati are inhabited by a mysterious monster that's killing people, Baahubali is sent to investigate and uncover the strange truth.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x6
episodes_data.description: The legendary sword of Katappa has been shattered but does the legend of the man extend beyond his sword?

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x7
episodes_data.description: Who is Beera and what has drawn this mysterious stranger to a quiet fishing village?

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x8
episodes_data.description: A food shortage exposes bitter hatreds buried deep within the people of Mahishmati and only Baahubali can stop a riot from engulfing the city in flames.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x9
episodes_data.description: Baahubali is thought to have unwittingly unleashed a curse upon Mahishmati and must now work to clear his name and lift the curse.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x10
episodes_data.description: Baahubali seeks to learn from Katappa's mysterious master but uncovers a dark secret that might expose Mahishmati to the greatest danger it's ever faced.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x11
episodes_data.description: The legendary Tournament Of Champions is to be held in Mahishmati and Sivagami wishes to use the opportunity to form alliances, but not every kingdom wants peace with Mahishmati.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x12
episodes_data.description: The Tournament of Champions is underway and as the gladiators fight in the arena a dark new threat arises.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 1x13
episodes_data.description: All of Mahishmati is in danger at the hands of a new threat and the future of the kingdom lies in the hands of Baahubali as he must confront and overcome this new menace.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 2x1
episodes_data.description: Desperate to find a cure for the ailing Katappa, Baahubali journeys to defend the great library of Jwalarajyam from a Barbarian assault. Finding Jwalarajyam surrounded by a gigantic horde of Barbarians, Baahubali must defend the library with only a handful of men.

episodes_data.title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends 2x2
episodes_data.description: As the battle to defend Jwalarajyam begins Baahubali must come up with a strategy that will help him and a handful of warriors fight off hundreds of armed Barbarians.
